_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global beverage and convenient food company with a complementary portfolio of brands, including Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker and SodaStream'; 'Our beverage and convenient food products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2025, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 16% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2025 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: PepsiCo's own FY2025 10-K says 'Our business can be adversely affected if e-commerce channels and hard discounters take significant additional market share away from traditional retailers or we fail to find ways to create increasingly better digital tools and capabilities for our retail customers to enable them to grow their businesses.' At the same time it sells through e-commerce itself: 'Our products are also available and sold directly to consumers on a growing number of company-owned and third-party e-commerce websites and mobile commerce applications.'. The stock trades at 23.5x FY26E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing the shift away from physical retail into PepsiCo's own sales specifically.

Live: PepsiCo's own FY2025 10-K, under 'Reduction in future demand for our products would adversely affect our business.', names among the shifts in consumer preferences that can reduce demand for its products 'diet (whether due to changes in consumer behavior and eating habits, increasing use of weight-loss drugs, such as GLP-1 medications, or other factors)'. The stock trades at 23.5x FY26E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GLP1) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing lower demand from weight-loss drugs into PepsiCo's own multiple.

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global beverage and convenient food company with a complementary portfolio of brands, including Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker and SodaStream'; 'Our beverage and convenient food products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2025, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 16% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2025 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.59x; +7% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.23; conservative 2yr +21%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -40.8%/yr (worst year FY16-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +4.6%/yr (FY26 rev guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +4.6%/yr (FY16-FY25 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +41.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2026-08-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.59x (69.5% downside to Bear $43 / +26.9% upside to Bull $179) | Adj composite 2.85 vs market 2.62: gap +0.23 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +7% above the EPP floor $132 (22x FY26E $6.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +20.6% total (+10.3%/yr) | At 23.5x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $187 sits above the BULL case; servings not reported for Q2 2026, forward revenues +3-5% (FY26 net revenue guide (constant currency)); e-commerce is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
